Text.Text: The contract is closed and final payment is approved. The range can return to supervised work. You've finished my Kill Box trials. I have no further work for you here.
Czerka accepts this contract at rank 50 in Rifle. Reach that rank, then return. Compensation follows qualified work.

A test cell in the Czerka range has gone off-contract and is running live kill-box drills. Recover its trial docket for my records. Defeat six Kill Box Adepts in Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Weapons Testing Facility. Their defeat secures the Kill Box Czerka Test Docket; bring it back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Arms, Store. I'll give you the Czerka Arms Test Range Key when you accept. Complete all five trials to earn the right to train Kill Box.

Here's the Czerka Arms Test Range Key. Use '[Enter Czerka Weapons Testing Facility]' in Smuggler's Moon, Corporate District. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat six Kill Box Adepts, then return with the Kill Box Czerka Test Docket.

A kill box is a fire lane with no exits that the target believes has several. Overlapping angles, sealed geometry, one outcome. Czerka sells the doctrine to militaries that can afford it. The cell in the range is giving out free demonstrations, and free is not a word this company recognizes.

Former employees - technically still on the books, since nobody who carries termination paperwork into the Czerka Arms Test Range has walked back out with it. They're running live trials on anything that moves in the lanes. Unsanctioned, unbilled, uninsured. Three words I will not have on my range.

The Kill Box Czerka Test Docket is their trial record - lane configurations, fire schedules, results. Redacted, but the redactions are ours. While the cell holds it, they can argue their trials are sanctioned. Once you hand it to me, they are trespassers with rifles. Contracts are wonderful things.
Defeat six Kill Box Adepts in Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Weapons Testing Facility. Their defeat secures the Kill Box Czerka Test Docket; bring it back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Arms, Store.
You've defeated six Kill Box Adepts. Let me see the Kill Box Czerka Test Docket.
Work order received. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the specialist trial when you're ready.

The specialists are running the blast-cell equipment outside approved limits. Recover the regulator. Defeat five Kill Box Specialists in Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Weapons Testing Facility. Their defeat secures the Kill Box Blast-Cell Regulator; bring it back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Arms, Store.
Your key still grants access to Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Weapons Testing Facility. Defeat five Kill Box Specialists to secure the Kill Box Blast-Cell Regulator, then return to me.

The adepts were students running drills. The specialists wrote the drills. Each one holds a lane and shapes it - crossfire timing, kill-zone spacing, herding angles. They will build a box around you while you admire your first shot. Don't admire. Move.

The Kill Box Blast-Cell Regulator meters charge to every test rifle on the line. In spec, it keeps the lanes survivable for staff. Out of spec, it turns a fire lane into an incineration lane. The cell prefers the second setting. My insurers, emphatically, do not.

Czerka security is bonded for theft, vandalism, and workplace disputes. A rogue cell running live-fire trials in a proprietary facility is none of those, and every guard I send in is a liability filing with a family attached. You, on the other hand, signed a waiver. Page four of the terms.

Defeat five Kill Box Specialists in Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Weapons Testing Facility. Their defeat secures the Kill Box Blast-Cell Regulator; bring it back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Arms, Store.
You've defeated five Kill Box Specialists. Let me see the Kill Box Blast-Cell Regulator.
Component received and accounted for. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the warden trial when you're ready.

The range warden protects the off-contract cell. Take the range crest and end that protection. Defeat the Kill Box Warden in Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Weapons Testing Facility. Their defeat secures the Kill Box Scored Range Crest; bring it back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Arms, Store. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Weapons Testing Facility, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Kill Box Warden. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. After the fight, return with the Kill Box Scored Range Crest.

He runs the proving lanes like an audit. Every angle you take, he has already scored; every piece of cover carries a failure rating he memorized years ago. Alone, you're a data point. Three of you, moving on separate clocks, and his whole scoring model comes apart. That isn't encouragement. That's the actuarial table.

The Kill Box Scored Range Crest is authority stamped in metal. Whoever wears it sets range law - schedules, access, live-fire authorization. It's the legal fig leaf over everything the cell does. Bring it to me and their last signature dies with him.

A two-partner assessment team out of the Corellian sector. Excellent scores, better references. They went in sequentially - that was the error. He closed the box on one while the other was still clearing the approach. I don't tell you this to frighten you. The fine print exists for a reason, and the reason has two names.

Defeat the Kill Box Warden in Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Weapons Testing Facility. Their defeat secures the Kill Box Scored Range Crest; bring it back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Arms, Store. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Kill Box Warden. Let me see the Kill Box Scored Range Crest.
The warden's defeat is verified. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the inner circle trial when you're ready.

Four officers still authorize the cell's tests. Recover their clearance chit. Defeat four members of the Kill Box Inner Circle in Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Weapons Testing Facility. Their defeat secures the Kill Box Czerka Clearance Chit; bring it back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Arms, Store.
Your key still grants access to Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Weapons Testing Facility. Defeat four members of the Kill Box Inner Circle to secure the Kill Box Czerka Clearance Chit, then return to me.

Founders. Czerka's original kill-box design team, from before they decided the doctrine was theirs and the paychecks were incidental. Each one drew a quarter of the lanes down there. Clearing them isn't just clearing the range. It's retiring the authorship.

Pooled clearance means no single founder can sell out the rest - the chit only countersigns while all four live to contest it. Sentimental, for people in the killing business. It also means that when the fourth one falls, the Kill Box Czerka Clearance Chit becomes an unclaimed asset. Czerka is very good at unclaimed assets.

The warden proved rifles. These four prove doctrine. He scored your angles; they will redraw the lanes around you mid-fight - the wall you counted on opening, the exit becoming a firing slot. Keep your crew tight and your geometry tighter. And remember they haven't fought inside each other's lanes in years. Rust is billable.

Defeat four members of the Kill Box Inner Circle in Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Weapons Testing Facility. Their defeat secures the Kill Box Czerka Clearance Chit; bring it back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Arms, Store.
You've defeated four members of the Kill Box Inner Circle. Let me see the Kill Box Czerka Clearance Chit.
Authorization recovered. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the final trial when you're ready.

The master is the final outstanding liability. Defeat him in the Czerka Blast-Safe Cell to close the contract. Defeat the Kill Box Master in Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Blast-Safe Cell. Report back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Arms, Store; no item is needed for this final trial. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Blast-Safe Cell, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Kill Box Master. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. Once the master is defeated, come back for the final lesson.

You have cleared lanes built from walls and angles. He doesn't need them. Wherever he stands, the exits are already covered and the crossfire is already scheduled - the same box you are about to earn the right to build, except he finished earning it years ago and kept going. When it's over, you will understand him better than I ever will. That is the one part of this contract I can't price.

Czerka didn't let him. Czerka lost him, then spent a decade pretending the deep range was decommissioned rather than admit a proprietary doctrine walked off the line inside one man. The cell worshipped him. He never once acknowledged them. I find that almost admirable. Almost.

Recertified, reopened, and renamed after some board member's daughter, probably. Czerka moves on; it is the company's one genuine talent. What happens to you is the more interesting line item. The doctrine has to live somewhere, and my recommendation will read that it should live in someone who signs their work.

Defeat the Kill Box Master in Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Blast-Safe Cell. Report back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Arms, Store; no item is needed for this final trial. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Kill Box Master. Give me your report and we'll finish the trial.
The contract is closed and final payment is approved. The range can return to supervised work. You've earned the right to train Kill Box. Your final payment is ready.
Back to the terms.
I'll defeat six Kill Box Adepts.
Define the deliverable. What is a kill box?
Who exactly am I clearing out?
And the docket? What's it to Czerka?
I'll review the terms first.
Here's the Kill Box Czerka Test Docket.
Back to phase two.
I'll defeat five Kill Box Specialists.
What separates a specialist from the six I cleared?
What does the regulator do for them?
Why not send Czerka security down there?
Hold the contract. I'll be back.
Here's the Kill Box Blast-Cell Regulator.
Back to the clause.
I'll defeat the Kill Box Warden.
How does the warden fight?
What is the crest worth, contractually?
Tell me about the two who didn't come back.
Not until my roster is filled.
Here's the Kill Box Scored Range Crest.
Back to the dispute.
I'll defeat four members of the Kill Box Inner Circle.
Who are the four?
Why pool their clearance into one chit?
Will they fight like the warden did?
Give me time to brief my crew.
Here's the Kill Box Czerka Clearance Chit.
Back to the final clause.
I'll face the Kill Box Master and report back.
What makes him the master?
How did Czerka let him get this far?
What happens to the range once he's gone?
When my crew is ready. Not before.
The Kill Box Master is defeated. Here's my report.
